baslik: The Wall That Released a Flood of Caustic Red Mud

sahneler.metin: A reservoir wall at a Hungarian alumina plant suddenly broke.
A flood of red mud swept through nearby villages, and ten people were killed.
The mud was waste from making aluminium.
It caused chemical burns to people and animals.
It flowed into rivers and reached the Danube.
The reservoir had been inspected shortly before.
Hungary then tightened rules for industrial waste reservoirs.

aciklama:
Ajka flooded villages with caustic red mud. The cause: structural failure of a reservoir dyke holding highly alkaline bauxite residue.
